title: Parmesan Broccoli Balls
description: This delicious Parmesan broccoli ball recipe blends frozen broccoli and Parmesan cheese with dry stuffing mix and is rolled into delicious appetizers.
ingredients: 1 (10 ounce) package chopped frozen broccoli, thawed
1 (6 ounce) package chicken flavored dry stuffing mix

steps.text: Place broccoli in a medium saucepan with enough water to cover. Cover, and bring to a boil. Cook 5 minutes. Uncover, and continue cooking 2 to 3 minutes, until tender. Remove from heat, drain, and cool.

In a large bowl, mix broccoli, stuffing mix, Parmesan cheese, onion, eggs, margarine, pepper, and garlic salt. Cover, and chill in the refrigerator approximately 1 hour, until moisture has been absorbed.
Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C).
Roll chilled mixture into 1-inch balls and arrange on a medium baking sheet.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until browned.

video.description: Want a healthier appetizer to share or a fun side? These little veggie balls come together quickly and bake up deliciously with a mixture of broccoli, stuffing, Parmesan cheese, onion and eggs. They’re tasty on their own, but think up a good dipping sauce if you like—pesto, cheese, aioli or marinara. Quick, easy, healthy and adorable—make ‘em today!
